child_list.content: Five Little Fishes
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Five little fishes are swimming in a pool.

The first one said, “The pool is cool.”

The second one said, “The pool is deep.”

The third one said, “I want to sleep.”

The fourth one said, “Let’s dive and dip.”

The fifth one said, “I spy a ship.”

The fisherman’s boat comes,

The line goes ker-splash,

And away the five little fishes dash.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 五条小鱼
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
五条小鱼池中游。

第一条小鱼说：“池水很凉。”

第二条小鱼说：“池子很深。”

第三条小鱼说：“我想睡觉了。”

第四条小鱼说：“我们潜水游泳吧。”

第五条小鱼说：“我发现了一条船。”

渔夫的船过来了，

扑通，扑通，连成一串，

五条小鱼溜走了。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
